title: Double Drip Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice brings together a vibrant medley of red berries with a crisp Menthol finish. The taste of sun-ripened Strawberry lays the foundation with a soft, mellow sweetness, while Raspberry adds a tangy twist and Cherry deepens the blend with its rich, juicy flavour. A brisk wave of Menthol rounds off the profile, keeping the vape cool, fresh, and clean from start to finish. Formulated with nicotine salts for rapid nicotine absorption and a smoother, more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits. It performs best with low-powered pod devices , vape pens , and starter kits . Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
